facts.text: I am looking for new vegan recipes to try out.
I have been experimenting with plant-based milk alternatives, including oat milk.
I tried making vegan mac and cheese using a cashew-based cheese sauce last week.
The vegan mac and cheese using a cashew-based cheese sauce turned out really well.
I am interested in trying out the Creamy Tomato Sauce.
I think penne pasta would pair well with the creamy tomato sauce.
I will pair the creamy tomato sauce and penne with roasted vegetables.
I will use roasted cherry tomatoes and zucchini with the creamy tomato sauce and penne.
I love the idea of adding a sweet and tangy contrast to the savory sauce.
I am going to try adding a roux to thicken the sauce.
I have heard that a roux adds depth of flavor.
I am going to try making a blond roux for my creamy tomato sauce.
I think a blond roux with a lightly golden color and nutty aroma will complement the flavors of the sauce.
I will add sautéed garlic and onion to the fat before adding the flour.
